title: Keep Little Zen navigation in its own window and finish the compact chrome
body:
## Summary

- Little Zen loads pages in its own window and the default container. `Ctrl+O` still moves the page into a Space afterward, and container-extension redirects stay in the little window.
- The frame, URL bar, and controls take their colors from the painted page, including while scrolling, and those samples are kept per site. Idle windows follow Zen’s chrome theme, and window controls darken on bright headers.
- Window controls can sit on the left. The Space picker sits on the opposite side, and the compact window is sized to the URL bar.
- The URL bar still uses Zen’s trimmed display. Zia’s toolbar and address-bar rules no longer override the little window.
- External links that are direct downloads stay in the normal window. The address is checked first, then the response headers, before a Little Zen window opens.
- The Space picker is a panel in the style of a Zen folder list: search, mouse and keyboard selection, regular menu type, and icons that follow the panel color.

title: feat: improve Little Zen windows, navigation, and toolbar
body:
## Context
12th offered to merge the features from my Little Zen version, except its one-line installer. This PR ports the remaining runtime and interface differences into the upstream mod. Features already present upstream stay in place.

## Included
- Keep links, searches, and container-extension redirects in Little Zen; do not apply Zen Space routing to its startup URL.
- Preserve the main Zen window's navbar and prevent Ctrl+Alt+tab click from also opening split view.
- Keep pinned extension buttons beside the sidebar URL bar until it is full, and use readable fallback colors on pages without theme colors.
- Size a compact Little Zen window to its URL bar, place the Space picker in the right-side toolbar spring, and align the toolbar and frame CSS with my version.
- Keep upstream's startup presentation helper while retaining the same user-facing behavior.

The non-Sine installation, one-line installer, and bundled fx-autoconfig files are intentionally excluded. Upstream's Sine mod packaging remains unchanged.

## Validation
- `node --check littleZen.uc.js`
- `git diff --check`
- `chrome.css` matches the CSS from my repo byte-for-byte.
- The pinned-extension flow was confirmed in my local Zen profile with the corresponding fork code. This upstream branch has not been installed separately for a UI check.

title: polish little zen loading and close behavior
body:
## Summary

- Add a blank Little Zen loading veil with a centered Zen-themed pulse while routed pages load.
- Smooth and move the loading indicator earlier in startup to reduce the brief glitched loading-page flash.
- Add a final URLbar positioning verifier for empty Little Zen windows.
- Allow double-tapping Escape to close Little Zen windows.

## Validation

- `node --check littleZen.uc.js`

## Notes

This PR is based on the current `main` after PR #1 was merged and contains only the follow-up loading, URLbar, and double-Escape changes.
